verdict.rationale: The evidence covers feature flags, audience targeting rules, flag prerequisites, and a management API for programmatic control. None of it documents user-defined rules that automatically trigger actions when events occur, such as auto-rollback or event-driven workflows. Targeting rules and prerequisites decide who gets which variant, and the API is a building block that would need external orchestration, so both are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
